pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal patches with rounded vertices and smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patch area is relatively consistent across the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more elongated shapes on the lower neck region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a grid-like topology. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections. Corridor width is relatively uniform throughout the mid-flank section.
